scope: AI-assisted single-system feasibility pilot; no human productivity or baseline comparison
source_version: Commit plus dirty working tree; source hashes below identify preparation inputs only
prior_knowledge: PERF-041/042/043 and six approximately-six-second reference renders are known. This goal is informed by that knowledge, not independently or blindly selected.
initial_snapshot: After initialContacts, before the first solver step; not frame zero after an update
screenshot_state_alignment: Record actual simulation serial and demo time. Old benchmark drain-end State is not interchangeable with a screenshot-time State.

fixed_configuration.camera: Unchanged Scene camera; animation camera tracks removed
fixed_configuration.appearance: Existing built-in lit effects, fixed lighting and display scale

editable: Existing ice_melting and water_cooling rate/modifier parameters; keep both rules
Add absorbedwetness and one existing inflowFraction waterfilm-to-absorbedwetness rule
locked: Direct wetness paint, scripted State removal, new phenomenon-specific code

gates.criterion: Runtime/Vulkan, finite/nonnegative State and input/settings provenance
At t=6, B total Ice / B initial Ice is in [0.05, 0.80]; Ice is visually recognizable at t=1
By t=8, waterfilm coverage >=0.10 outside B initial Ice coverage >=0.10 footprint occupies >=1% of B reference upper-face area

At t=12, 14 and 16, the same texels outside the B initial Ice coverage >=0.10 footprint occupy >=1% of B reference upper-face area, have waterfilm <=0.05, Ice <=0.05, absorbedwetness >=0.25, and had waterfilm >=0.10 at an earlier recorded checkpoint. Their lit trace is visible at normal viewing scale.
Fresh-process reload preserves final profile/rules and passes G0-G3 again; report actual differences, do not demand bitwise pixels

metric_definition: coverage = clamp(amount / (profileCapacity * WorldTexelArea * 256^2),0,1). Use fixed macro reference-area weights and top-face identity from geometry, not render vertex IDs, pixel counts or presumed surface ID.
threshold_status: Task design choices, not physical constants, literature standards or measured results; freeze for this pilot and version any revisions, retaining failures.
visual_gate: An assessor marks the normal-size fixed-camera lit trace without heatmap/difference amplification; location must overlap the numerical G3 region. AI self-review is provisional and cannot substitute for an independent human quality assessment.
limitations: Per-checkpoint same-step State/geometry captures and top-face area masks not yet prepared
A checkpoint visit mask is a lower bound on visited area, not a per-step provenance proof
No per-step full material ledger for this new rendered task
No human session, comparison intervention or new-mesh generalization
stopping_rule: At most six recorded profile candidates, then one fresh-process replay of a successful submission. Stop on the first complete provisional pass; retain failed candidates. If none pass, report goal unmet within the declared budget, not impossible in principle.
model_claim: Successful output establishes feasibility of this task only, not novelty or relative ease.
